description: Build a downloadable file for one or more articles identified by content_id and publisher_identifier. Do not pass article text. On the Paid plan the file includes the full article body. On Free Discovery the file contains titles, metadata, and summaries only. Returns an https download link that expires in about 2 hours. Does not count against search quota. A paid full-article delivery is metered once when the file is created.

articles.description: Articles to export. One file contains every item.

content_id.description: Single-article shortcut. Use with publisher_identifier instead of articles.

mime_type.description: Optional MIME type: text/markdown, application/json, or text/csv.

publisher_identifier.description: Publisher catalog id for the single-article shortcut.

name: export_articles
title: Export articles
